verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Edge0 is a local model runner that ships desktop and mobile apps. However, the evidence only shows a model-fetch script, self-contained model directories, adapter-file swapping, and CLI flags like --no-lora. None of these is a unified place to manage downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations; they are developer building blocks and adjacent features. Nothing in the pack mentions saved prompts or a model/config management UI.
